tagline: AI-native crypto intelligence and trading for Solana
note: All posts are about the OrbitX app (this repo). Not 'OrbitX City'. No fabricated metrics, users, P&L, or executed trades. Demo visuals are labeled CONTENT DEMO / MOCK DATA.

posts.title: Meet OrbitX
posts.hook: Most crypto apps bury you in tabs. OrbitX is one AI you talk to — it does the digging, you make the call.
points: Ask about any token, wallet, or protocol in plain English.
The agent plans the work, runs live tools, and answers.
Built for Solana, mobile-first, non-custodial by design.
posts.why: The interface is the conversation — not a wall of dashboards.
posts.punch: This is the front door to everything OrbitX can do.

posts.title: The home screen is a conversation
posts.hook: Open OrbitX and there's no maze of menus. There's a chat.
points: Type like you'd text a sharp trader friend.
Casual questions get casual answers; a mint gets a full report.
Type @ to summon a specific tool by name.
posts.why: You shouldn't have to learn an app to use it. You just talk.
posts.punch: Say what you want. OrbitX figures out the how.

posts.title: A full token report from one mint
posts.hook: Paste a contract address. Get a real briefing — not a number soup.
points: Identity, market, liquidity, and volume in one place.
Holders, mint/freeze authority, and LP status.
Sources cited; the chain is the source of truth.
posts.why: Finding a token is easy. Understanding it is the hard part.
posts.punch: Context first. Action second.

posts.title: OG Scan: the forensic layer
posts.hook: OrbitX ships with OG Scan — the investigative side of the app.
points: Risk signals, dev history, and wallet behavior.
First buyers and sniper clusters surfaced fast.
Designed to help you investigate before you click.
posts.why: Influencers hype. Narratives lie. The chain doesn't.
posts.punch: Investigate before you ape.

posts.title: Safety checks, before anything else
posts.hook: OrbitX runs safety heuristics up front so you see red flags early.
points: Honeypot signals and transfer restrictions.
Mint authority renounced? Freeze authority live?
Liquidity locked, or one wallet away from a pull?
posts.why: The best trade is sometimes the one you don't take.
posts.punch: Green candles are optional. Not getting rugged isn't.

posts.title: Your wallet, finally readable
posts.hook: The wallet tab is a real portfolio view — not just an address.
points: Total value, 24h / 7d change, and SOL balance up top.
Every holding with amount, USD value, and price.
Allocation % of your bag and % of supply you hold.
posts.why: You can't manage what you can't see.
posts.punch: Open the wallet tab and actually understand your bag.

posts.title: Wallet intelligence on any address
posts.hook: Paste any wallet and ask OrbitX what it's actually doing.
points: Holdings, behavior, and counterparty exposure.
PnL hints and activity patterns over time.
Turn a raw address into a story you can reason about.
posts.why: Smart money leaves footprints. OrbitX reads them.
posts.punch: See the signal behind the address.

posts.title: Quote → preview → sign
posts.hook: When it's time to trade, OrbitX never becomes the authorization layer.
points: Jupiter quote first, with route and price impact.
A clear preview of exactly what you'll sign.
Nothing broadcasts until your wallet signs it.
posts.why: The model plans. Your wallet authorizes. Always.
posts.punch: AI convenience, self-custody safety. No compromise.

posts.title: Trade prep without the tab chaos
posts.hook: OrbitX pulls quotes, previews, and checks into one flow.
points: Ask for a quote in the same chat you researched in.
See slippage, route, and warnings before you commit.
Confirm in-wallet — or walk away — in one place.
posts.why: Fewer tabs means fewer mistakes.
posts.punch: One workflow. Less chaos.

posts.title: Alerts that watch for you
posts.hook: Markets move at 3am. You shouldn't have to.
points: Set price, wallet, and migration alerts in plain English.
Let the agent watch conditions while you sleep.
Get pinged when something you care about happens.
posts.why: Attention is your scarcest asset. Spend it wisely.
posts.punch: Let the agent watch. You decide.

posts.title: The agent tool terminal
posts.hook: OrbitX isn't a black box. You watch it work.
points: A mini terminal shows every tool the agent calls, live.
See what ran, what's running, and what failed.
If a tool fails, OrbitX tells you — it never fakes results.
posts.why: Trust comes from transparency, not vibes.
posts.punch: No black box. See the work.

posts.title: 250 skills, one command layer
posts.hook: OrbitX now ships with a library of 250 built-in skills.
points: Trading, DeFi, intelligence, security, wallet, and knowledge.
Each skill maps to real tools the agent can run.
Discover them by name — no memorizing commands.
posts.why: Power is useless if you can't find it.
posts.punch: Tools should be discoverable. Now they are.

posts.title: Specialist agents on tap
posts.hook: Behind the chat is a bench of specialist agents.
points: Token analyst, security guard, wallet analyst, trading desk.
The right specialist is picked for the job.
Each one is scoped to a safe set of tools.
posts.why: One generalist can't beat the right specialist.
posts.punch: A whole desk of analysts in your pocket.

posts.title: Type @ to pick a tool
posts.hook: Want a specific tool? Just type @ and it appears.
points: Mentions autocomplete as you type.
Fire a single tool or let the agent orchestrate many.
The command palette makes everything one tap away.
posts.why: Great tools disappear until you need them.
posts.punch: Discoverable by design.

posts.title: Holder & first-buyer forensics
posts.hook: Who's actually holding this — and who got in first?
points: Holder concentration and smart-money overlap.
First buyers and sniper wallets with timestamps.
Bundle and cluster detection to spot coordination.
posts.why: The cap table tells you who's really in control.
posts.punch: Follow the wallets, not the hype.

posts.title: One composite risk score
posts.hook: Dozens of signals, distilled into one honest read.
points: Safety, liquidity, and holder data combined.
Transparent factors — you see why the score is what it is.
Built to warn early, not to shill.
posts.why: A single number you can actually trust — because you can see inside it.
posts.punch: Risk you can read at a glance.

posts.title: Paper trade before you commit
posts.hook: Test an idea with live quotes and zero risk.
points: Simulate entries and exits against real prices.
No on-chain execution, no funds at stake.
Kept strictly separate from your live wallet.
posts.why: Conviction is cheaper to build in simulation.
posts.punch: Practice the trade before you take it.

posts.title: Research you can keep
posts.hook: OrbitX can turn a scan into a shareable brief.
points: Structured reports for a token or a wallet.
The facts, the risks, and the links — organized.
Great for your own notes or your group chat.
posts.why: Good research compounds when you can save and share it.
posts.punch: From scan to report in one ask.

posts.title: Your keys, your coins
posts.hook: OrbitX creates an in-app wallet — and you can export it anytime.
points: Export runs on a secure page at ogscan.fun.
Your private key loads in an isolated environment.
OrbitX never sees it. Move to any wallet you want.
posts.why: Self-custody isn't a feature — it's the whole point.
posts.punch: Not your keys? Not with OrbitX.

posts.title: Your account, at a glance
posts.hook: The profile tab pulls your identity together.
points: Display name, wallet address, and network.
Copy your address or open it in Solscan.
Quick links to wallet, settings, and export.
posts.why: Everything you need, one tap from the chat.
posts.punch: Clean, fast, and yours.

posts.title: You set the permissions
posts.hook: OrbitX puts you in control of what the agent can do.
points: Read-only: analysis, zero writes.
Confirm every action: you approve each step.
Limited automation: pre-approve a safe set.
posts.why: Autonomy should be a dial you control — not a default.
posts.punch: As hands-off, or hands-on, as you want.

posts.title: Non-custodial by design
posts.hook: Convenience shouldn't cost you custody.
points: Every swap, launch, or mint needs your signature.
Private keys stay in a secure environment — never in OrbitX.
The app can never move funds on its own.
posts.why: AI should assist you, never replace your consent.
posts.punch: The agent proposes. You dispose.

posts.title: Serious tooling, in your pocket
posts.hook: OrbitX is built mobile-first with Expo.
points: Real market tooling that feels native on a phone.
Not a desktop terminal crammed onto a screen.
Research, watch, and trade from anywhere.
posts.why: The market doesn't wait for you to get to a desk.
posts.punch: Your trading desk fits in your hand.

posts.title: A safe demo, real UI
posts.hook: Want to look before you connect anything? There's a demo mode.
points: Fictional balances and mock tokens — clearly labeled.
No wallet, no auth, no network trades.
Explore the real interface with zero risk.
posts.why: You should be able to kick the tires without a login.
posts.punch: Zero real funds. Zero real auth. Just the product.

posts.title: Come build with us
posts.hook: OrbitX is early, and that's the best time to show up.
points: An AI that researches, watches, and preps trades.
Self-custody, transparency, and safety baked in.
New capabilities landing every week.
posts.why: The best tools are shaped by the people who use them early.
posts.punch: Talk to your markets. Try OrbitX.
